displayIdentity.body: The promise leads to cleansing and holiness. Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
displayIdentity.title: The promise leads to cleansing and holiness
